headline.purpose: Section introductions using the shared heading role; source: src/styles/global.css.

title.purpose: Homepage project captions. Project-index title sizing is a separate responsive treatment; source: WorkSection.astro.

body-large.purpose: Shared lede text with the normal reading measure; source: src/styles/global.css.

body.purpose: Base Archivo reading style. Supporting paragraphs frequently use 0.9375rem with the same family and open leading.

label.purpose: Button typography; ordinary text links use the inherited body leading.

meta.purpose: Technology lists and shared metadata. Natural case, lower contrast than body; never a decorative pre-heading.

shadows.name: product-capture
shadows.purpose: Soft lift beneath the Convia and Mizan screenshot wraps, unchanged between system themes. Source: WorkSection.astro.

shadows.name: project-control-glass
shadows.purpose: Inset highlights and small diffuse lift for the project arrow when backdrop filtering is supported. Fixed product-control material in both themes; solid background fallback when transparency is reduced.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared deceleration curve from --ease; used by controls, disclosures, menu, showcase images, and the name entrance.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Shared color, border, arrow, disclosure, and drawer transitions from --dur.

motion.name: showcase-transform
motion.purpose: Local screenshot movement on showcase hover. Convia changes from -5deg to -3deg, and Mizan from -7deg to -4deg, each lifting 5px.

motion.name: hero-settle
motion.purpose: Homepage-only entrance under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; translateY 16px to 0 and tracking -0.025em to -0.04em.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, global animation and transition durations nearly disappear, animations run once, and scroll behavior is auto. Drawer, scrim, and menu-bar transitions are explicitly none.

narrative.overview:
The Product Monograph gives real work room to speak. Pale green paper, charcoal type, clear hierarchy, and generous space create a professional setting for product imagery, an authentic portrait, and engineering explanations. The interface is calm; the artifacts provide character.

Light and dark follow the visitor’s operating system. Surfaces remain flat, with small translucent details on the scrolled navigation and project arrow controls. Motion responds to attention and action: short control transitions, a restrained name entrance, and gentle movement of product captures.

This record describes the finished implementation. Its shared language is reusable; the centered homepage name, PKI-first sequence, individual showcase colors, screenshot angles, and project order are compositions specific to their surfaces. Their direction remains in `.impeccable/surfaces/src-pages-index-astro.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Real photography, verified product captures, and clearly conceptual system diagrams.
Archivo throughout, with expressive headings and compact supporting metadata.
Pale green and green charcoal system themes with restrained orange punctuation.
Flat surfaces, fine rules, native disclosures, and limited liquid glass.
Readable responsive layouts with visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use the active semantic CSS variables for the interface. Keep product-image colors within their own showcase; they do not become a second site-wide accent palette.

rules.name: The Explicit Weight Rule
rules.body: Set Archivo’s weight explicitly. Its variable-font default is 600; unqualified font use can silently make supporting text too heavy.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Let imagery occupy broad fields while explanatory copy stays within a readable measure. Reflow columns when the content requires it; do not scale a desktop layout down as a single unit.

rules.name: The Limited Glass Rule
rules.body: Use translucent blur for the scrolled header and project arrow controls. Both retain solid backgrounds when backdrop filtering is unavailable or reduced transparency is requested.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use real assets or labeled conceptual diagrams to explain the work. Keep controls quiet enough that the project remains the subject.

dos: Do use semantic colors so text, fields, borders, and controls adapt together to the operating-system theme.
Do keep project titles before their smaller role and year metadata.
Do preserve visible focus, native disclosure semantics, and the label–control–error relationship.
Do label demo-data imagery and conceptual diagrams accurately.
Do use the supplied portrait and verified product imagery, with provenance retained.
donts: Don't introduce gradients; the confirmed world uses flat color.
Don't replace the real portrait with a generated avatar.
Don't spread the localized glass treatment across reading surfaces.
Don't turn a homepage arrangement, showcase hue, or screenshot angle into a rule for every page.
Don't replace authored SVG interface icons with text glyphs or icon-font characters.
